import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { relationMembers } from "../../../backend/schema/relation_members";

// A board over "memberType" fits this table, but a board needs a text column to keep each card's order in. Add one, then declare kanban: { columnField: "memberType", orderField: "<that column>" }.
export const relationMembersCms = customizeTable<typeof relationMembers>("relation_members", {
    icon: "Users",
    display: {
        title: "memberRole"
    },
    fields: {
        memberRole: {
            multiline: true
        }
    },
    fieldOrder: ["relationId", "version", "sequenceId", "memberType", "memberRole", "memberId"]
});
